obligation: Oil discharge notice to the National Response Center
trigger: Discharge of oil in a quantity that may be harmful (40 CFR 110.3: violates water quality standards or causes a film or sheen on the water or adjoining shorelines), for example a tank overflow or flow line release after loss of SCADA control
deadline: Immediately, as soon as the person in charge has knowledge
notify: National Response Center (800-424-8802); if not practicable, the Coast Guard or EPA predesignated on-scene coordinator
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - if a release reaches water; the Field Superintendent decides and calls

trigger: Unauthorized access to electronic personal information of Florida residents (royalty owners: names with Social Security or bank account numbers; employees: Social Security, driver license, or health plan numbers)
deadline: As expeditiously as practicable and no later than 30 days after determination of the breach or reason to believe a breach occurred; delay only on written law enforcement request; no notice if a documented no-harm determination is made after investigation and consultation with law enforcement (kept 5 years; sent to the Department of Legal Affairs within 30 days)
notify: Each affected Florida resident (mail or email)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - about 90 Florida royalty owners and 7 employees could be affected

obligation: Florida notice to the Department of Legal Affairs
trigger: Breach affecting 500 or more individuals in Florida
deadline: No later than 30 days after determination (a covered entity may get 15 more days for the individual notices in 501.171(4) if good cause is given in writing within the 30 days)
applies_at_this_tier: No - the company holds personal information of about 97 Florida residents; recheck if the owner list grows past 500

obligation: Florida notice to consumer reporting agencies
trigger: Notice to more than 1,000 individuals at a single time
applies_at_this_tier: No - fewer than 160 individuals in all

obligation: Vendor breach notice to the company (inbound)
trigger: A third-party agent (production accounting vendor, payroll service, or the MSP through the cloud backup) has a breach of a system it maintains for the company
deadline: Vendor must notify the company no later than 10 days after determination; the company then gives the 501.171(4) notices

citation: State breach notification statutes (all 50 states, DC, PR, USVI; Guam 9 GCA Ch. 48)
trigger: Breach of computerized personal information of residents of other states (about 50 royalty owners live outside Florida)
deadline: Varies by state (for example 'without unreasonable delay' or a fixed number of days)
notify: Affected residents; state attorney general or regulator where the state requires it; consumer reporting agencies above state-set counts
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - counsel applies the law of each state where affected individuals reside

obligation: OFAC sanctions check before any ransom payment
citation: OFAC Updated Advisory on Potential Sanctions Risks for Facilitating Ransomware Payments (Sept. 21, 2021); 31 CFR ch. V
deadline: Before any payment; full and timely reporting to law enforcement or CISA is a mitigating factor
notify: OFAC (license if sanctioned party); law enforcement (FBI) or CISA

obligation: Voluntary report to CISA and the FBI
citation: No legal requirement for this company (see CIRCIA row); CISA and FBI reporting channels
trigger: Ransomware or any intrusion that reaches the SCADA host
deadline: As soon as practicable; the runbook targets day 0 to 1
notify: CISA (cisa.gov/report or 844-729-2472); FBI field office or IC3
applies_at_this_tier: Voluntary - recommended; supports the OFAC mitigating factor and warns other producers

deadline: Per policy: prompt notice through the breach hotline before hiring any vendor

citation: Crude purchase contract; joint operating agreements; seismic data license (contracts)
trigger: Incident that stops crude deliveries, affects partner data, or exposes licensed seismic data
deadline: Per each contract (delivery disruption notices to the purchaser; partner notices under the joint operating agreements; licensor notice of unauthorized disclosure)
notify: Crude purchaser; 2 non-operating partners; seismic data licensor
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - contractual; the Owner checks each contract with counsel

obligation: Reporting of actual or threatened cyber incidents at MTSA facilities / OCS facilities / vessels
trigger: Cyber incident involving or endangering a vessel, harbor, port, or waterfront facility
deadline: Immediately (6.16-1); 'without delay' to the National Response Center for entities not reporting under 6.16-1
notify: FBI, CISA (for any cyber incident), and the Coast Guard Captain of the Port; or National Response Center
applies_at_this_tier: No - onshore only; no vessel, waterfront facility, or OCS facility (N21-R01 not applicable, P03 G-113)

trigger: Cybersecurity incident at a TSA-notified pipeline owner or operator
deadline: As soon as practicable, but no later than 72 hours after identifying a cybersecurity incident
notify: CISA Central (cisa.gov/report or 844-729-2472); CISA shares with TSA
applies_at_this_tier: No - the company operates no pipeline and has no TSA notice (N21-R02 not applicable, P03 G-114)

obligation: CIRCIA covered cyber incident report / ransom payment report (PROPOSED - not yet in effect)
trigger: Covered cyber incident or ransom payment by a covered entity
deadline: Proposed: 72 hours after reasonable belief a covered cyber incident occurred; 24 hours after ransom payment disbursed
applies_at_this_tier: No - final rule not published as of 2026-09-25; as proposed, the company is far below the SBA size standard and meets no sector criterion (P03 G-115); recheck when final

obligation: Covered telecommunications equipment or services discovered
trigger: Contractor identifies covered telecommunications equipment or services in use or delivered
deadline: Within 1 business day of identification (further report within 10 business days)
applies_at_this_tier: No - the company holds no federal contracts or subcontracts

trigger: Contractor identifies a covered article (Kaspersky Lab hardware, software, or services) in use or delivered
deadline: Within 3 business days of identification (further report within 10 business days)
applies_at_this_tier: No - the company holds no federal contracts or subcontracts
